traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Dipentodontaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins dentate; veins pinnate; leaves deciduous; blades ovate; stipules present; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in umbels; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 5 to 7; stamens 5 to 7; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
